name: NLM Configuration Parameter Definitions
description: Detailed documentation for all NLM configuration parameters with examples and usage notes

parameters.name: random_seed
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducible experiments. Use a fixed value for deterministic behavior across runs.

parameters.name: simulation_timestep
parameters.description: Simulation timestep in seconds. Smaller values provide better accuracy but increase computation time.

parameters.name: neuron_count
parameters.description: Number of neurons in the brain. Adjust based on model complexity and available memory.

parameters.name: region_count
parameters.description: Number of brain regions. Regions can represent different functional areas or processing modules.

parameters.name: connection_probability
parameters.description: Probability of connection formation between neurons. Higher values create denser connectivity.

parameters.name: plasticity_learning_rate
parameters.description: Base learning rate for plasticity mechanisms. Controls the speed of synaptic weight changes.

parameters.name: stdp_ltp_weight
parameters.description: Spike-timing dependent plasticity long-term potentiation weight. Strength of LTP when presynaptic spike precedes postsynaptic spike.

parameters.name: stdp_ltd_weight
parameters.description: Spike-timing dependent plasticity long-term depression weight. Strength of LTD when postsynaptic spike precedes presynaptic spike.

parameters.name: stdp_time_constant
parameters.description: Time constant for STDP decay. Controls how quickly the STDP effect decays over time.

parameters.name: development_synaptogenesis_rate
parameters.description: Rate of synaptogenesis during development. Controls the formation of new synapses during neural maturation.

parameters.name: development_pruning_rate
parameters.description: Rate of neural pruning during development. Controls the elimination of weak synapses during maturation.

parameters.name: dopamine_baseline
parameters.description: Baseline dopamine level for neuromodulation. Sets the background dopamine concentration affecting learning and motivation.

parameters.name: reward_discount_factor
parameters.description: Discount factor for reward signals. Controls how future rewards are valued relative to immediate rewards.

parameters.name: environment_name
parameters.description: Name of the simulated environment. Used for logging and identification.

parameters.name: environment_width
parameters.description: Width of the simulation environment in grid cells or units.

parameters.name: environment_height
parameters.description: Height of the simulation environment in grid cells or units.

parameters.name: log_level
parameters.description: Logging verbosity level. Controls the amount of detail in log output.

parameters.name: log_to_file
parameters.description: Enable/disable file logging. Set to true to write logs to file instead of only console.

parameters.name: log_filename
parameters.description: Filename for log output. Used when log_to_file is enabled.

parameters.name: max_simulation_steps
parameters.description: Maximum number of simulation steps before automatic termination.

parameters.name: simulation_time_limit
parameters.description: Absolute time limit for simulation in seconds. If zero, unlimited by time (only step limit).

parameters.name: visualization_enabled
parameters.description: Enable/disable visualization features. Provides real-time visualization of neural activity.

parameters.name: visualization_update_rate
parameters.description: Frame rate for visualization updates in Hz. Controls how frequently the visualization refreshes.
